      "name": "ipc",

      "evidence": "Modifies src/bitcoin.cpp and src/util/exec.cpp to fix process spawning and waiting for the bitcoin wrapper executable on Windows.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "The bitcoin wrapper was broken on Windows because CRT _execvp exited the parent immediately with code 0 without waiting for child processes. Fixing this ensures IPC binaries work correctly and pass tests on Windows, re-enabling skipped functional test coverage."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes in test_framework.py and functional test scripts merely follow the wrapper fix by re-enabling previously skipped Windows tests.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Does not alter core test infrastructure; the test edits merely follow from the wrapper fix to re-enable tests skipped due to the Windows bug."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Explicitly covers the bitcoin wrapper binary (src/bitcoin.cpp).",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.6,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a platform defect where external callers and scripts invoking bitcoin.exe on Windows could not wait for child processes or inspect exit status."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies util::ExecVp in src/util/exec.cpp to handle Windows process spawning, waiting, and errno translation correctly.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Corrects util::ExecVp on Windows to wait on the spawned child process and use std::generic_category() for POSIX errno reporting instead of std::system_category()."
    }
  ],
